source: data/routes/7.md -- transcribed from the live clear that ended in room 8 at (2719,-1704). Origin is 'live': each route ran once on this machine against the real game, not just against the mock.

routes.name: 7-spawn-to-e2
routes.note: Starts on the spawn tile. The jump is mandatory: the block at 2632..2656 has its underside level with her feet and walking right stops dead at x 2628.

routes.name: 7-e2-to-e3
routes.note: Jump 27px, dash 69px, then a wall bounce that peaks at -1601 and the left:4 brake that keeps it from overshooting to x 2764. Without the brake, ten earlier variants fell out of the room.

routes.name: 7-e3-to-room-8
routes.note: Four alternating wall jumps in the 24px shaft at x 2712..2736. The 12-frame crossings are travel time between walls, not padding. Ends in room 8, which is why the landing is outside room 7's bounds.
